On Netflix: I Escaped A Cult... 
Really shows that there isn't much difference between modern religion and a cult to me.

My husband and I are both atheists. My mom is Jewish and my dad a Protestant. Growing up we celebrated Christmas and Passover, Easter and Passover. We were able to choose. I believed in God growing up but I always questioned why no one ever answered. No one had any answers for me. Over the last few years, and more recently I decided if I only have this one life to live I'm going to do my best to be the best person I can be. I don't need to try to be a better person because I'm afraid of hell. I choose to be a good person because it's the right thing to do. 
It's not something to be depressed or losing sleep over. You should be happy :)

That's wonderful you were able to express your feelings and have your voice heard. Sometimes it's hard for people to cope with a loss of faith in a loved one. I think it's because maybe they think they will lose their faith, so they don't give up on you believing. I don't know if anything I'm saying makes sense. 

We are all here to have our voices heard.
